content.comment_body: Thanks in advance to anyone who can assist me. Is it possible to generate a graph in [product_name] Web Editor, such as displaying temperature data from a log file?
No, this isn't possible with the web editor.
You can use Microsoft Excel to create graphs. Simply export the log data from [product_name] and generate the graphs externally.

analysis.insight_summary: Users looking to visualize log data found that [product_name] Web Editor does not support graph generation, such as plotting temperature trends from logs. This limitation was confirmed, leading users to consider external tools for visualization. The main usability concern is the lack of native data graphing features within the web editor.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to create graphs directly in [product_name] Web Editor using log file data.
